# Time

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A period or point in time, at any horizon from a day to a life.

## Scope note

Treated as the anchor/parent for the Calendar hierarchy (Life > Decade > Year > Quarter > Month > Week > Day). Worth deciding OWL Time alignment before finalizing.

## Editorial note

_An open question about this term, not part of its definition._

It might be useful to consider additional time terms, such as "Time Period", "Interval", or "Duration" (with start & end times), as well as an "Instant", "Timestamp", or "Event Time" (point in time).
